description: This file defines the CustomFieldModel class, which implements the Normalizable interface and uses ModelTrait to represent a custom field in the OrangeHRM PIM module. It sets up the entity, filters, and attribute names for serialization and API responses.

classes.name: CustomFieldModel
classes.description: Model class representing a CustomField object for the OrangeHRM API, with serialization and filtering capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CustomFieldModel with a CustomField entity, setting filters and attribute names for API serialization.
